results.title: UFC 324: Gaethje vs. Pimblett
results.overview: UFC 324: Gaethje vs. Pimblett was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on January 24, 2026, at the T-Mobile Arena in Paradise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Valley, United States.

results.title: Aaram
results.overview: An honest police officer finds himself ensnared in a web of guilt, fear, and moral conflict as institutional pressure and personal integrity collide.

results.title: Squatch
results.overview: After discovering a Sasquatch in the Smoky Mountains, park rangers Robert and Sam find themselves in over their heads when tech giant Alphazon plans to destroy its habitat. With no real authority and even less of a plan, they decide to relocate the creature themselves, driving it cross-country to the Pacific Northwest. Watch as Robert and Sam try to do one small, wildly impractical good thing.

results.title: Land of Shadows
results.overview: Following a tragic event that shattered her life, renowned author Alice Chevalier struggles to find meaning in her existence. Searching for answers and a sign from destiny, she meets Thomas, a mysterious man who offers her an experience that defies the boundaries of reality. Driven by the hope of rebuilding herself, Alice embarks on a mystical journey, like an astronaut venturing into the far reaches of the unknown.

results.title: Journeys
results.overview: A deep dive into the rapidly expanding world of Psilocybin Psychedelic Therapy. How it's being used in large (Heroic) and microdose form for PTSD, depression, end-of-life care, as well as the science, ethics and structure of the practice.

results.title: Wild Strawberries
results.overview: After unexpectedly inheriting an old house in a remote Rhodope village from her 103-year-old grandmother, whom she had never met, Daphne Bello, an American woman with Bulgarian roots, is about to give up everything to unravel the mysterious past of her long-deceased father, Georgi, in the hope that this will help her rediscover herself.

results.title: Nuevas Raíces
results.overview: After fleeing the war in Ukraine, several families rebuild their lives in a village in Seville. Through different conversations and introducing us to their day-to-day, Nuevas raíces shows their process of adaptation, resilience and rooting in a land that, without seeking it, also begins to be home.

results.title: The Invisible Guest
results.overview: Accused of murdering her lover, a young businesswoman hires a brilliant lawyer. With only three hours left, they must uncover what really happened.

results.title: S. Saraswathi
results.overview: A devoted mother whose life is shattered when her 12-year-old daughter goes missing. Desperate for answers, she turns to the police for help, but as the investigation unfolds, unexpected twists begin to deepen the mystery.

results.title: Dead End
results.overview: Located in a futuristic Dhaka City from the 2100s. We follow Zayn Khan our protagonist, a genius engineer trying to fulfill his father's dream. However, he gets intertwined with a street racing gang named 'The Hawks', lead by Alvan Haque.

results.title: Christmas Pop-Up
results.overview: Desperate for a fresh start, an unlucky-in-love set decorator takes a job designing a Christmas Eve pop-up event for a jaded celebrity chef, hoping to escape her current hell - living with her ex and his new girlfriend - before they get engaged on New Year’s Eve.

results.title: Solos
results.overview: Four friends reunite in a pleasant dinner with the only objective of enjoying their lives next to a wine glass and away from personal problems. Nevertheless, insatisfaction starts to appear as the night progresses and disquieting topics arise, such as fear, couple life, friendship, sex, work, complicity or death.

results.title: Winter Ceremony
results.overview: A long-divorced Chinese couple reunites in Texas for their daughter’s college graduation.  The mother stays in the daughter’s small apartment, while the father returns each night to a hotel room of his own. The daughter drifts between her parents and her own thoughts.  At times, they appear to be a family.  After years of absence, what remains between them goes unspoken, as the father keeps his distance, lingering nearby.

results.title: The Cowboy Killer
results.overview: When a delusional killer in a cowboy costume starts treating a small town like his personal shooting range, two bumbling detectives must track him down and free his captive bride before he kills again.

results.overview: an elsie fisher joint

results.title: Chers parents
results.overview: A trio of siblings faces turmoil when their parents reveal they've won the lottery but refuse to share a cent, unraveling buried secrets, unspoken tensions, and deep-seated jealousy that shake the family to its core.

results.title: The Last Warrior: Kolobok
results.overview: Kolobok decides to change his fate and unwittingly becomes the partner of the humble baker Tikhon.

results.title: NJPW Road to Destruction 2026 - Day 1
results.overview: The first night of Road to Destruction 2026 took place on September 5, 2026 at Light Cube Utsunomiya in Utsunomiya, Tochigi, Japan.

results.title: Crybaby
results.overview: Home for the first time in years, Hannah is dragged to do the big Christmas shop at Tesco. Cue: abject horror. The last thing she wants is to bump into everyone she went to school with and confirm her fear that she's a failure. Simple: she just wont get out of the car.

results.title: Juan Tamariz: Amor y Magia
results.overview: The long-awaited film is a portrait of The Maestro, Juan Tamariz. The film is a look at magic through the lens of one of the most influential magicians alive today.
